message: stands under <ng-container> with no role and a global ARIA attribute (`aria-label`)
$reason: An `<ng-container>` written in capitals. The compiler tells an `<ng-container>` by its local name in its case (`op.tag === 'ng-container'`) and lowers the name for the schema, so `<NG-CONTAINER>` compiles under `strictTemplates` and draws an element of the DOM, an `<ng-container aria-label>` around the option (measured: Angular 22.2; axe 4.13 reports the listbox). axe does not look through a role-less element with a global ARIA attribute, so it owns the option, and a listbox may not own it. The walk lowered the name before asking whether the tag was Angular's own, looked through the element, and passed the option. The message names the tag lowered, as every other message does.
